note: Voice: alloy, the same voice as PULSE 02, so the September Pulses sound like one person. PULSE 04 is the lightest of the four, so the direction is slower and warmer than PULSE 02's. The situations are spoken because they are the same for everybody. The three choices and the participant's own Pulse Back are never spoken: a voice reading someone their own decisions back turns a mirror into a report.

direction._: calm and warm, slightly slower than conversation, like a kind colleague. Plain delivery. Say only the script and stop immediately after its last word; add nothing, continue nothing.
direction.enter: calm and plain, a short statement said once. Stop right after the last word.
direction.wheel: light and friendly. Stop right after the last word.
direction.sit: plain and conversational, describing an ordinary workday moment to a colleague. Neutral: nothing in the tone may hint at which way to decide.
direction.reveal: calm and unhurried, noticing something rather than teaching it.

en.sit-O: A decision is waiting. The person who normally owns it is unavailable. The team can move if someone makes the call.
en.sit-P: The current process works, but it keeps creating the same friction. A new approach could help, but it has not been tested here.
en.sit-T: You can already see a project may slip. The team is still trying to recover it. Nothing is confirmed yet.
en.sit-I: The team is already moving with an agreed plan. You see another approach that may work better, but introducing it now could reopen the discussion.
en.sit-C: Two teams disagree on what should happen next. You could make the call yourself and move faster.
en.sit-S: The quickest fix will solve today's problem, but it will probably create the same work again next month.
en.reveal-1: You made the decisions. The situations changed.
en.reveal-4: Values don't make decisions for us. They shape how we make them.
en.reveal-5: Repeated choices become behavior. Behavior becomes culture.
en.pulseback: Here are the three calls you made.
en.callback-1: Information can help. Experience can help. A I can help.
en.callback-2: But none of them should replace the thing at the center.
en.final-1: Find what matters. Decide what moves.

id.sit-O: Sebuah keputusan sedang menunggu. Orang yang biasanya memegangnya sedang tidak ada. Tim bisa jalan kalau ada yang mengambil keputusan.
id.sit-P: Proses yang sekarang berjalan, tapi terus menimbulkan hambatan yang sama. Cara baru bisa membantu, tapi belum pernah diuji di sini.
id.sit-T: Kamu sudah melihat sebuah proyek mungkin meleset. Tim masih berusaha memulihkannya. Belum ada yang pasti.
id.sit-I: Tim sudah bergerak dengan rencana yang disepakati. Kamu melihat pendekatan lain yang mungkin lebih baik, tapi mengajukannya sekarang bisa membuka diskusi lagi.
id.sit-C: Dua tim tidak sepakat soal langkah berikutnya. Kamu bisa memutuskan sendiri dan bergerak lebih cepat.
id.sit-S: Perbaikan tercepat akan menyelesaikan masalah hari ini, tapi kemungkinan besar menimbulkan pekerjaan yang sama bulan depan.
id.reveal-1: Kamu yang membuat keputusan. Situasinya berubah-ubah.
id.reveal-2: Tapi apa yang menuntun keputusan itu?
id.reveal-4: Nilai tidak membuat keputusan untuk kita. Nilai membentuk cara kita memutuskan.
id.reveal-5: Pilihan yang berulang menjadi perilaku. Perilaku menjadi budaya.
id.pulseback: Ini tiga keputusan yang kamu ambil.
id.callback-1: Informasi bisa membantu. Pengalaman bisa membantu. A I bisa membantu.
id.callback-2: Tapi tidak satu pun seharusnya menggantikan yang ada di pusatnya.
id.final-1: Temukan yang penting. Putuskan yang bergerak.
